name: Sugar+Spice! Party☆Party
source:
This is the fandisc for Sugar+Spice!

As the days, weeks and months pass, we finally come to our final school festival before graduation.
Beneath that blue sky, the lively cheers of the students echo within the school.
Accompanying me as I walk down the vibrantly-decorated hallways is the girl I love.

All right, it’s our final school festival!
Let’s make the most of it!

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/shugapurasusupaisupathipath-ja/]Johren[/url]]
